digest.component_or_area: plan review and completion verification gates
propositions: Implement a configurable typed [verify] maximum-description setting with an 8,000-character default; exactly 8,000 characters is admitted and 8,001+ is blocked.
Plan review must return deterministic BLOCK with coverage.llm_ran=false before any LLM call when a ticket description exceeds the configured maximum.
In light bug review, partition DET blocks to retain only blocking P4 description findings in det_blocking and downgrade other DET blocks to advisory.

Completion verification must check the authoritative ticket description immediately after loading the [verify] setting and return validated deterministic FAIL with zero runner calls if it exceeds the maximum.
AC-count and file-impact P4 signals remain advisory; description-size block is the only P4 signal that becomes blocking.
No gate shall truncate or elide ticket content; force lifecycle commands remain the escape hatch.
